run_download_cifar10: run the script to download CIFAR10 train and valid splits as individual PNG images
run_download_cifar10_to_dir: run the script with an output directory to save CIFAR10 images to a custom path
run_overwrite_cifar10: run the script with the overwrite flag to re-download and re-save existing CIFAR10 splits
review_main_function: review the main function that downloads CIFAR10 data and saves images as class-labeled PNG files
summarize_cifar10_prep: summarize the CIFAR10 data preparation script that downloads and extracts images by class and index
